notes.title: STB Update 1.18 !!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25027130/e1a4a3c2465001df8b0c5dc0d463674d66c98a8d.png

Now STB Update 1.18 Now!!


● Upgrade balance changed
- Max upgrade 15 -> 20
- Upgrade price down


http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25027130/77947939a6bf8abb642f4229f997b7f0e1f8c040.jpg
You will be able to enjoy the game more enjoyable!


● Include PS4 pad cofig
You can find PS4 pad config in that folder.
Steam\steamapps\common\SMASHING THE BATTLE\Pad_Config

Execute STB_PS4pad_Config.reg file.
And you can use PS4 pad!



● Fixed
- Title screen bug fix
- Minor bug fixed




Thank you for playing :) !!!
Have a good day!

notes.title: STB Update 1.10 !!
notes.notes:
http://i.imgur.com/o2I1NjA.png


Now STB Update 1.10 !!


Fixed
- STB support Game Launcher.
You can change resolution, window mode, select monitor, remaping keys.

http://i.imgur.com/u4RXP6r.jpg
It's not cool, but solve a lot of problems  :)

- Controller tutorial visible just 1 stage.
- Some minor bug fixed.
- Japanese font problem fixed.


If you use PS4 pad, please download this file!
https://drive.google.com/open?id=0B_m74Vw2dbxzNW9KQkRCdl9GNXc
It's my PS4 pad setting file. (STB_PS4pad_Config.reg)
You can double-click and yes, use PS4 pad.

Or you can change key maping in game launcher :)

*If your controller work well, do not install that file.


今PS4 Padをサポートします。
このファイルをダウンロードしてください。
https://drive.google.com/open?id=0B_m74Vw2dbxzNW9KQkRCdl9GNXc
STB_PS4pad_Config.regを実行すると、PS4 Padが動作します。
またはLauncherで自分だけのセッティングをしてください。

*もし、すでにうまく動作する場合のインストールしないでください。



And Trading card support NOW! 

Thank you for waiting!!
